/.title: Duleko - Find skilled workers and local work in Nepal
/.description: Duleko is a local skills marketplace for Nepal. Find nearby electricians, plumbers, tutors, tailors and more, or create a free profile and turn your skill into work and income.

/search.title: Find skilled workers near you | Duleko
/search.description: Search electricians, plumbers, carpenters, tutors, tailors, cooks, drivers, designers and other skilled people across Nepal by skill, district and availability.

/about.title: About Duleko - Founder and team | Duleko
/about.description: Duleko was founded by Sunil K. Chaudhary to connect local skills with local opportunities in Nepal. Meet Sunil, Sanjay Gupta and Dipendra Chaudhary, the team behind it.

/about/sanjay-gupta.title: Sanjay Gupta - Tech Lead of Duleko
/about/sanjay-gupta.description: Sanjay Gupta is the Tech Lead of Duleko who designed and built the platform - web app, Android app and backend. Software Engineer from Chitkara University. Portfolio: guptasanjay.com.np.

/about/sunil-k-chaudhary.title: Sunil K. Chaudhary - Founder & Product Lead of Duleko
/about/sunil-k-chaudhary.description: Sunil K. Chaudhary from Kapilvastu, Nepal, founded Duleko and leads its product vision, strategy and partnerships. He studies Mathematics and Economics at Haverford College and the University of Oxford.

/about/dipendra-chaudhary.title: Dipendra Chaudhary - Community Lead of Duleko
/about/dipendra-chaudhary.description: Dipendra Chaudhary is the Community Lead of Duleko and leads community outreach, user support and communications. Hospital Pharmacist at Lumbini Provincial Hospital, B.Pharm from Tribhuvan University.

/mission.title: Our Mission - Making skills discoverable | Duleko
/mission.description: A skill should not need a shop to become a business. Duleko gives skilled people in Nepal a virtual space to be discovered and connect with real opportunities.

/individuals.title: For Individuals - Turn your skills into opportunities | Duleko
/individuals.description: Students, professionals, trained workers, farmers and tradespeople: create a free Duleko profile, show your skills and availability, and get found by people nearby.

/businesses.title: For Businesses - Find the skills your business needs | Duleko
/businesses.description: Find skilled people in Nepal for a specific job without hiring permanently. Search by skill and district on Duleko and connect with them directly.

/partners.title: For Municipalities & Training Providers | Duleko
/partners.description: From skill training to skill utilization: municipalities and training providers in Nepal can use Duleko so trainees showcase their skills and find real work.

/safety.title: Trust & Safety | Duleko
/safety.description: Phone verification, work requests, reviews, report and block, and privacy controls: how Duleko keeps connections between people in Nepal safer.

/motivation.title: Our Motivation - Why we built Duleko | Duleko
/motivation.description: Why founder Sunil K. Chaudhary and the Duleko team, Sanjay Gupta and Dipendra Chaudhary, built a platform to turn local skills in Nepal into local opportunities.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy | Duleko
/privacy.description: How Duleko collects, uses and protects your information. Your data is never sold, your phone number stays private and location is on your terms.

/terms.title: Terms of Use & User Policy | Duleko
/terms.description: The terms for using Duleko: Duleko connects people but does not employ them, payments are between users, and honesty is required.

/registration-policy.title: Registration Policy | Duleko
/registration-policy.description: Duleko's user registration policy: what you agree to when you create an account on Duleko.
